question: Should the deterministic Testbox crash-window tests be accepted as sufficient proof, or must this PR add a live Telegram or WhatsApp reconnect/suspension trace before merge?
rationale: The implementation and focused tests are strong, but the contributor-associated PR does not satisfy the real-behavior proof gate and its protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Require live trace
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted logs or terminal output show provider-in-flight recovery blocking suspend readiness, prepared-state fencing, and safe completion after resume.

options.title: Override proof gate
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused concurrency tests and broad Testbox validation as sufficient for this internal runtime path.
